strings.seo.faq[0].q: Mbega pdff ni ku buntu koko?
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Ego cane. Igikoresho cose ni ku buntu, nta kimenyetso c'akamenyo kandi nta kibuze inyuma y'ubwishyu bw'ukwezi. Nta karata ya banki isabwa.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Oya. Nta kwiyandikisha, nta aderesi ya imeyili: ukoresha ibikoresho ako kanya.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Oya. Dosiye zawe zikoreshwa gusa ku gikorwa waciye ubaza, maze zigasibwa. Nta n'umwe uzisoma kandi ntizigera zisangiwa.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Ego. pdff ikora mu mucaca w'amaterefone yose, tablet canke mudasobwa (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), nta kintu co gushiramwo.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, amafoto (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC (iPhone), TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML n'andi menshi.

strings.privacy.title: Ibanga
strings.privacy.description: Uburyo pdff yitwararika dosiye zawe: nta konti, nta nyandiko ibitswe, nta matangazo n'ukugurisha amakuru.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff yubatswe kugira inyandiko zawe zigume ari izawe. Hejuru yaho, mu majambo asanzwe, ni iki kiba iyo uyikoresheje.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Dosiye zawe
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Zirungikwa zifunitse (HTTPS), zigatunganywa mu buryo bwikora, maze zigasibwa uko ibyavuyemwo biba biteguriye. Dosiye nini zica mu bubiko bw'igihe gito ku izina ry'akajagari kandi zisibwa igikorwa kirangiye; isukurwa ryikora risiba ikindi cose cosigara mu masaha 24.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Nta konti, nta makuru yihariye
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff ntisaba kwiyandikisha, aderesi ya imeyili canke karata ya banki. Inyandiko zawe ntizemewe gusomwa, gusesengurwa, gusangirwa canke gukoreshwa mu kwigisha ubwenge bw'ubukorozi (AI).
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Igipimo c'abasura
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Tubarira ingendo mu buryo bw'ibanga nta kimenyetso c'ukwibuka (Vercel Web Analytics) kugira tumenye ibikoresho bifise akamaro. Nta matangazo, nta gukurikirana.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Ubwibuka
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Agatonyanga kamwe k'ubwibuka gashobora guhitamwo: kwibuka ururimi wahisemo.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Ubwakiriro
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Urubuga rwakirwa na Vercel ku maseriveri i Paris; ihindurwa rya Word, Excel na PowerPoint rifashwa na Render i Frankfurt. Aba batanga seriveri bitwararika dosiye gusa igihe zihindurwa.

strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: pdff yateguwe, yubakwa ikanasohorwa na Mikailou Cedric Toure, umukozi w'ikoranabuhanga ubarizwa i New Brunswick, muri Kanada.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: Uruhusha rw'ubuntu rwo gukoresha, kuri bose
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: pdff ni ubuntu, nta kwiyandikisha nta n'igihe ntarengwa, kuri bose: abantu ku giti cyabo, abanyeshuri, abarimu, amashyirahamwe, imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta, inzego za Leta na za guverinoma, muri Kanada no mu yindi migabane yose. Nta gice cyagenewe gusa abishyura, kuko nta gihari. Dosiye mukora ziba ari izanyu rwose: nta kashe na imwe zifite nta n'aho pdff ivugwa.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: Inyandiko zanyu zose, n'izibereye ibanga
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: Mushobora gutunganya ubwoko bwose bw'inyandiko, harimo n'izibereye ibanga, kuko pdff idasoma, ngo igenzure, ngo ibike cyangwa ngo isangize dosiye zanyu: zitunganywa mu buryo bwikora hanyuma zigahita zisibwa. Mugumana uburenganzira bwazo, kandi ni mwe mufite inshingano yo kugira uburenganzira bwo kuzitunganya.
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].title: Inkomoko ya code no kuyishyira ku mbuga zanyu
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: Inkomoko ya code ya pdff isohowe munsi y'uruhusha rwa MIT. Ushobora kuyisoma, kuyigenzura, kuyishyira ku mbuga zanyu bwite (harimo n'izitari ku miyoboro ifite Interineti), kuyihindura no kuyigabanya ku buntu, ku buryo mugumana ubutumwa bw'uburenganzira bw'umwanditsi n'inyandiko y'uruhusha.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Imikoreshereze yemewe
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: Ntushobora gukoresha pdff mu bikorwa bitemewe n'amategeko, kugerageza guhungabanya serivisi (kuzana dosiye nyinshi mu buryo bwikora, kugerageza kwinjira aho utemerewe) cyangwa kurenga imbibi zayo z'ikoranabuhanga. Ingano n'umubare wa dosiye birinda serivisi kuri bose.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Ububasha bwo kuboneka
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: pdff itangwa ku buntu. Ishobora guhinduka, guhagarikwa kugira ngo ivugururwe cyangwa ikavaho burundu. Buri gihe jya ubika inyandiko zawe z'umwimerere: pdff nta kopi yazo ibika.
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].title: Garanti n'inshingano
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].text: Serivisi itangwa “uko iri”, nta garanti y'ubwoko bwose. Ku buryo bwuzuye bwemewe n'amategeko, uwashyize ahagaragara ntabazwa ibyangiritse byimbitse, gutakaza amakuru cyangwa ibyavuye mu guhindura bituzuye. Genzura inyandiko mukora mutarayikoresha mu bintu bikomeye.
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].title: Uburenganzira bw'umuhanga
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: Izina rya pdff, ikimenyetso cyayo n'inyandiko zo ku rubuga ni iz'uwashyize ahagaragara; code iri munsi y'uruhusha rwa MIT nk'uko bivuzwe haruguru. Ibibonekamo bivugwa (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…) ni ibya bene byo.
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].title: Amategeko agenga
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].text: Aya mategeko agengwa n'amategeko y'Intara ya New Brunswick n'amategeko ya Leta ya Kanada ajyanye nayo. Inkiko za New Brunswick zifite ububasha, hatabangamiwe uburenganzira amategeko y'igugu cyawe aguha nk'umuguzi.

strings.legal.security.title: Umutekano n'amakuru
strings.legal.security.description: Ibibera kuri dosiye zawe kuri pdff: gutunganya mu buryo bwikora, nta igenzura, gusibwa ako kanya, encryption, kubitsa mu Burayi, hamwe n'amahitamo yo kuyishyira ku mbuga zanyu bwite.
strings.legal.security.intro: Ibibera kuri dosiye zawe, aho zitunganyirizwa n'uko zirengererwa: bisobanuwe mu buryo bworoshye, ku bantu ku giti cyabo n'abakozi b'ikoranabuhanga kimwe.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Nta nyandiko zibitswe
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Dosiye zanyu zitunganywa mu buryo bwikora, hanyuma zigahita zisibwa vuba cyane uko igisubizo kibonetse cyangwa gikuweho. Nta kopi ihari, nta bubiko bw'inyuma nta n'amateka ahari. Isukurwa rya buri munsi rikorwa mu buryo bwikora risiba n'izindi dosiye zose z'agateganyo zishobora kuba zasizwe, bitarenze umunsi ukurikira.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Nta igenzura
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Nta n'umwe usoma inyandiko zawe. Ntizishyirwa mu bubiko bw'ingenzi, ntizigenzurwa, ntizisangizwa cyangwa ngo zikoreshwe mu kwigisha ubwenge bw'ubukorano (AI). pdff nta konti igira, nta yamamaza nta n'ibiranga abakoresha.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Encryption
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Uhuza wese arinzwe (HTTPS) kandi urubuga rutegeka encryption kuri buri gusura (HSTS). Igikoresho cyo kurinda gishyira encryption kuri ma PDF zawe hakoreshejwe AES-256; ijambo ry'ibanga wihitiyemo ntirigera ribikwa.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Aho dosiye zawe zitunganyirizwa
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Urubuga,ibikoresho bya PDF n'amafoto: Vercel, ikigo cy'ububiko i Paris (Fransa, Ubumwe bw'Uburayi). Guhindura Word, Excel na PowerPoint: Render, i Frankfurt (Ubudage, Ubumwe bw'Uburayi). Dosiye zirenga MB 4: ububiko bw'agateganyo bwa Vercel Blob, bafite izina ryitwa uko ryaje, zisibwa nyuma yo gukoreshwa.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Ingamba z'ikoranabuhanga z'umutekano
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Umutekano wo hejuru (HSTS, kubuza urubuga kwinjizwa mu zindi mpapuro, kurinda urujijo rw'ubwoko bwa dosiye), aho dosiye z'agateganyo ziba zidashobora gutekerezwa, na serivisi yo guhindura yemera gusa ibisabe byikoreye ubutumwa bw'ibanga. Buri mpinduka ya code igenzurwa mu buryo bwikora (ibigeragezo, igenzura ry'ubwoko) mbere y'uko isohoka.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Ubuzima bwite n'amategeko akurikizwa
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: pdff isohorerwa i New Brunswick kandi yubahiriza Itegeko rya Kanada ryo Kurinda Amakuru y'Umuntu n'Ubutumwa bwa elegitoroniki (PIPEDA). Ntiteranya amakuru y'umuntu ku giti cye ku bakoresha bayo: nta konti, nta aderesi ya imeri, nta cookie yo gukurikirana. Yubatswe ku mahame amwe n'ay'Uburayi ya GDPR n'Itegeko rya 25 rya Québec: kugabanya amakuru, kutayongera kuyakoresha, gusiba nyuma yo kuyatunganya.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Ku miryango ifite amategeko akomeye
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Niba amategeko yanyu abuza kohereza inyandiko kuri serivisi yo hanze, shyira pdff ku mbuga zanyu bwite. Porogaramu yuzuye ni ubuntu, ni inkomoko ifunguye kandi ikora nta Interineti: nta dosiye n'imwe isohoka ku murongo wanyu. Amabwiriza yo kuyishyira ari ku rupapuro rw'umushinga.

strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: Inkomoko yuzuye ya code iragaragara kuri bose: amatsinda yanyu y'umutekano ashobora kugenzura buri jambo muri aya.

strings.legal.accessibility.title: Uburyo bwo kugera kuri byose
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Ubusobanuro bwa pdff ku buryo bwo kugera kuri byose: Intego ya WCAG 2.2 urwego rwa AA, ingamba zashyizweho, imipaka izwi n'uko wamenyesha imbogamizi.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Buri wese agomba gashobora gukoresha pdff, harimo abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona cyangwa bafite ibibazo byo kutabona neza, abatumva cyangwa abafite uburwayi bwo kumva, cyangwa abafite ubumuga bw'ubumuga bw'umubiri cyangwa bw'ubwenge.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Intego y'urwego
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdff igamije guhuza n'Amabwiriza y'Uburyo bwo Kugera ku Bintu byo kuri interineti (WCAG) 2.2, urwego rwa AA, urwego mpuzamahanga rwa W3C. Uru rwego rukurikiza ibyo Itegeko ry'Igihugu cya Kanada risaba ku bijyanye n'Uburyo bwo Kugera ku Rubuga, urwego rw'Uburayi rwa EN 301 549 na Igice cya 508 muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika, zivuga kuri WCAG 2.0 cyangwa 2.1 urwego rwa AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Uko bihagaze
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdff ifite aho ihurira n'ibivugwa na WCAG 2.2 urwego rwa AA: imipaka izwi yanditswe hepfo. Ubu busobanuro bushingiye ku igenzura ry'imbere ryakozwe ku ya 2 Ukwakira 2026, hifashishijwe ibikoresho bikora byonyine (axe, Lighthouse) n'igenzura ry'intoki (urufunguzo rwa mudasobwa, itandukaniro, kwagura, gutangaza). Nta igenzura ryigenga rirakorwa kugeza ubu.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Ibyashyizweho
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Urubuga rwose rukoreshwa n'urufunguzo rwa mudasobwa, rufite umurongo wa "Simbira ku vyari muri nyuma" n'agashushanyo kagaragara ku kintu gikora. Itandukaniro ry'inyandiko ni nibura 4.5:1. Intambwe y'igikorwa (kuzana, ibyavuye, ikosa) bitangarizwa abasoma b'amajwi. Urutonde rwa dosiye rushobora guhindurwa hatabayeho kujyana no kurekura, hakoreshejwe utubuto. Urubuga rukurikiza amahitamo y'igikoresho cyawe yo "kugabanya kugenda": amashusho ahita ahagarara burundu. Impapuro ziguma zisomeka ku kwagura kwa 400% no kuri telefoni. Ururimi rwa buri rupapuro ruravugwa, kandi Icyarabu kigaragara ku buryo bwo gutangirira iburyo kikajya ibumoso.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Imipaka izwi
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Hatabayeho ayo mahitamo, amashusho y'imitako (inyuma, uruziga, urwego rw'ubwoko) akora ubudatuza; urwego rurahagarara iyo umuntu agiye hejuru yarwo n'urufunguzo rwa mudasobwa. Uruziga rw'amashusho ku rupapuro rw'ibanze rukoreshwa n'imbeba cyangwa urutoki; ni umutako, kandi urutonde rw'ubwoko rwerekana ruboneka kandi nk'inyandiko ku rupapuro. Indimi zahinduwe n'inzira ya mudasobwa zishobora kugira amakosa make. Amaherezo, ubushobozi bwo kugera ku nyandiko yatewe bushingiye ku y'umwimerere: pdff ntongeraho ibimenyetso by'ubushobozi bwo kugera ku nyandiko kuri PDF itabifite.
